title: Representative proceeding
description: Procedure for a consumer referred to in sub-clause (v) of clause (5) of section 2

steps.step: Complainant files a complaint as a representative of consumers
District Commission applies provisions of Order I Rule 8 of the First Schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 with modifications

documents: Order I Rule 8 of the First Schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 with modifications
Complaint or the order of the District Commission thereon

Where the complainant is a consumer referred to in sub-clause (v) of clause (5) of section 2, the provisions of Order I Rule 8 of the First Schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 shall apply subject to the modification that every reference therein to a suit or decree shall be construed as a reference to a complaint or the order of the District Commission thereon.
